{{Top|leg}}
'''Ornuks''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of bipedal animal. They were among the creatures exhibited at [[Sok Brok's Fiftieth Annual Pet Show]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] claimed that a large Ornuk had nearly bitten his ankle off as part of a ploy to distract [[Seff Hellin]] who also attended the show.
